marker: PENDING-WORDS marks a string whose final words are not yet set; HELD marks a string withheld from this file.

LABELS.L4.reason: The grant path agent gets a grant name and a copy of the broker token, which every agent shares and which can't act on an account alone, and never the customer's password or a token for the account.

LABELS.L10.reason: On every screen that shows the grant path, and in the limits: a copy of the credential with the grant name is accepted as this agent.

SCREENS (offline card): \"Run the four g.reason: The card sentence as ruled, whether the deck carries it or this export puts it in place. It names what the block allows: the connections between the demo's own processes. The browser and the server that serves it run outside the block.

SCREENS (offline subB).reason: Added beside the subhead until the deck carries it: the subhead of the measured state when the scenario runs did not count 0 outbound attempts. The view selects it.

SCREENS (offline cols[0].title).reason: In place of the deck's left column title until the deck carries it: it names how that run was made, the way every run of the demo is made.

SCREENS (summary cta.selfLead).reason: The lead as ruled, whether the deck carries it or this export puts it in place. It names the install step.

SCREENS (summary limits item 17).reason: In place of the deck's item until the deck carries it: the broker is an unreleased local build with no provenance attestation, and it answers grant requests on a local TCP port as well as on its Unix socket. The second sentence stays while that port answers an authenticated grant request at the pin.

RULED_EXTRA.fictionalLine.reason: Required on every screen and every screenshot; placement ruled.

RULED_EXTRA.l6ScopeVariant.reason: Printed instead of L6 when a minted token's scope is not the consent id.

RULED_EXTRA.restartTook.reason: Follows L12 on the scenario 3 panel.

RULED_EXTRA.offlineNotMeasured.reason: The second sentence of the result line when the count is not measured; {reason} is one of offlineNotMeasuredReasons.

RULED_EXTRA.offlineNotMeasuredReasons.reason: A closed list in the order that picks the reason shown: the earliest that holds. The result records every reason that holds.

RULED_EXTRA.offlineNotRun.reason: The right column's outcome when the rerun's root process wrote no hello line.

RULED_EXTRA.offlineNotRunResult.reason: The result line in that state; {reason} is one of offlineNotRunReasons.

RULED_EXTRA.offlineNotRunReasons.reason: A closed list, one reason per cause.

RULED_EXTRA.offlineNotRunNeeds.reason: The why line in that state, keyed by its reason: what the check needs.

RULED_EXTRA.offlineNoDecision.reason: The text runner's words for a scenario whose run returned no decision, moved here from the runner with its bytes unchanged. No screen shows them.

RULED_EXTRA.buildNotFromGit.reason: The build part of the footer when the demo does not run from a git clone, in place of the build and its sha.

RULED_EXTRA.pageLead.reason: The website demo page's problem lead.

RULED_EXTRA.pageAnswer.reason: The website demo page's one-line answer.

RULED_EXTRA.pageLeadShort.reason: The page lead's cut form, used in its place when the page's served test fails.

RULED_EXTRA.pageAnswerShort.reason: The page answer's cut form, used in its place when the page's served test fails.

PENDING_WORDS.offlineDiffersRow.reason: The words for a blocked run's decision that differs and that no row of the offline screen names; the row's tag after them is rowDifferent. Until they are set the row stays empty.

bin/start.mjs launcher lines.reason: Refusal, ready and stop lines in the words ruled for the start command.
